goal: Based on REFERENCE_0, add a deep brown short beard to Elon Musk that matches his age, without making his cheeks appear heavier or altering his expression.

reference_0.assumed_input: Assumed original image: A half-length portrait of Elon Musk facing the camera, clean-shaven, short hair, slight smile, wearing a black round-neck shirt, medium gray brushed background, symmetrical soft light on both sides, with slight eye bags under his eyes and slightly rosy cheeks

edit.scope: Facial part: Add neat short sideburns that connect at the temples, covering the jawline and area beneath the lower lip, with the upper lip having trimmed beard and clearly defined philtrum; color depth is deep brown, with local gray-white beard strands that are not exaggerated, uniformly dense
edit.retain: Size of eye slits, nose shape, mouth crack curvature, smile muscle position, forehead lines, ear shape, hairline, black T-shirt and background
edit.lighting: Generate Subtle Highlights and Under-Chin Transmitted Shadows in the Same Direction as the Main Light on the Beard, Without Redrawing the Main Light Ratio of the Whole Face

do_not: Change the contour of the head and face bone structure or the length of hair.
Add big items like earrings or glasses
must: Identifiable as the same person, no paper-cut feeling on beard edges
